text:
emma-peopleops: heads up — bulk invite we ran last night (v2-import) seems to be sending interview invites in PST for candidates who are in CET/IST. got 6 no-shows this morning from EMEA. anyone seeing similar?

matt-eng: ugh. saw something similar in staging last week where the CSV parser defaulted to company_tz when timezone column was empty. did we change the import behavior recently?

sarah-recruiter: confirmed from our side — the CSV we uploaded had a header 'candidate_tz' (I used the template from recruiting/ops) but the import preview showed "timezone" as the mapped field. attached sample: 
```
email,first_name,last_name,interview_time,candidate_tz
alice@example.com,Alice,Ng,2026-03-24T10:00,Europe/Paris
bob@example.com,Bob,Chen,2026-03-24T11:30,Asia/Kolkata
```
It looked fine in the UI preview but actual invites went out with 10:00 PST instead of 16:00 CET for Alice.

henry-ats: investigating. I'm pulling the import logs now. quick note: we shipped a small migration last month that normalizes timezone fields and falls back to account_default_tz when parse fails. might be related.

ops-bot: [deploy] ats-import-service v1.14.3 deployed by @henry-ats — no errors in deployment step.

matt-eng: ok can you paste the import log for that job id? there should be a line stating which tz column key was used.

henry-ats: log snippet: 
```
[2026-03-23T22:03:12Z] job=import-789 status=parsed_rows=120 tz_column=timezone fallback=account_default_tz
[2026-03-23T22:03:14Z] job=import-789 invite_send=ok invites_sent=120
```
so the parser mapped the header to `timezone` (not `candidate_tz`) during normalization. looks like our header aliases list doesn't include `candidate_tz`.

laura-peopleops: is there a quick fix we can apply for the impacted candidates this morning? I can coordinate resend if there's a script.

matt-eng: temporary workaround: run the resend utility with explicit tz mapping. e.g.:
```
./scripts/resend_invites --file affected_chunk.csv --tz-field candidate_tz --dry-run
./scripts/resend_invites --file affected_chunk.csv --tz-field candidate_tz --apply
```
I'll drop a utility that rewrites invites with correct timezone.

sarah-recruiter: thanks — can you also add `candidate_tz` to the header alias list in repo? we'll rerun the full import after fix.

henry-ats: will add alias and patch import service tomorrow morning. leaving a note to run a one-off migration to remap any stored invites where tz=account_default_tz and candidate_tz present in original CSV.

emma-peopleops: can we also surface a warning in the UI preview if a timezone header alias is unknown? that would have prevented this.

matt-eng: good idea. I'll propose a small change: show unmapped headers as yellow and require confirm. low effort.

laura-peopleops: also scheduling a short interviewer ops training next Tues 09:30 PT to go over bulk-invite best practices and the updated CSV template. invite sent to #people-ops calendar. :calendar:

sarah-recruiter: appreciate it — I'll re-notify the EMEA panel and apologize for the confusion.

emma-peopleops: thanks team. I'll track action items: 1) matt add UI warning, 2) henry add alias + migration, 3) matt provide resend utility, 4) laura run training. updating the incident tracker now. :white_check_mark:
